newsitem.title: UK: LME copper little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper little changed in late trading.

text.p: LME copper was barely changed in late inter-office trading on Tuesday evening.
At 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,507/13 compared to a afternoon kerb close of $2,507.
With momentum indiators giving off overbought signals, prices were likely to continue to consolidate or may dip slightly, analysts said.
Support was pegged at $2,480/90, then around $2,440/50, with nearby resistance at last week's one-year high of $2,530.
Nickel was indicated a barely weaker at $7,280/300 after suffering deep losses and closing on the kerb at $7,301.
Aluminium was also a shade easier at $1,632/33 compared to $1,636.
